prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose path mascot carousel layout redesign: Redesign the choose path screen into an interactive carousel layout highlighting different pet creation journeys.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "carousel"}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet voice and sound preview new screen in adoption: Add a dedicated pet audio preview screen during adoption where users can test pet sound effects and voice clips.
   config: {"new_pet_sound_preview": {"headline": "Listen to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Preview how your pet speaks and reacts while living on your screen.", "components": [{"type": "sound", "action": "play", "label": "Play Sample Audio", "style": "playful"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_sound_preview", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [sign_in, redesign] Compact single column account sign in redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a compact single-column card focusing on cloud pet backup protection.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet Progress", "body": "Link your account to keep your desktop companion safe and synchronized across devices."}}
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop pet interaction mode setup new flow: Add an interactive pet interaction mode selection component on the final intro screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "action": "choose", "label": "Choose Companion Desktop Mode", "style": "rounded"}]}}
4: [adoption, copy] Photo upload clarity and retry guidance copy: Update body copy on the photo upload screen to provide explicit formatting and lighting recommendations.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"body": "Upload a bright, front-facing photo with clear contrast so your custom 3D companion renders accurately."}}
5: [adoption, layout] Pick friend mascot carousel layout: Switch the pick friend companion selection screen layout to a carousel for browsing pet species.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel"}}
6: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign in after adoption certificate screen: Move sign-in step to occur right after completing the adoption certificate screen before pet rendering begins.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop rendering tip display on waiting screen: Display helpful desktop interaction tips on the waiting screen while rendering takes place.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Desktop Tip: Right-click your pet anytime on the screen to open quick controls or send your companion to sleep.", "tip_delay_seconds": 8}}
8: [finish, incentive] Desktop pet quick start mastery badge on finish screen: Add a prominent companion readiness badge component on the home intro screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Companion Active & Ready", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [finish, redesign] Home intro story scroll layout redesign: Redesign the home intro finish screen into a story scroll layout presenting key desktop pet shortcuts.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion!"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the choose path screen layout into a carousel inside onboarding is permitted.
Adding a new sound preview screen within onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.
Redesigning sign-in layout and copy inside onboarding is permitted.
Adding desktop mode selection components to home intro is allowed.
Updating photo upload instructions copy inside onboarding is permitted.
Changing the pick friend selection screen to a carousel layout is allowed.
Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Adding rendering tips to the waiting screen is permitted.
Adding a readiness badge component to the home intro screen is allowed.
Redesigning the home intro screen into a story scroll layout is permitted.
